name: Immunology
boundaries: Immunology: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: Added: IMM-11. Therapeutic reversal is also covered by IMM-04.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal antigen design for mutable viruses
original_dispositions.reason: The historical demand for sterilizing, lifelong protection against every strain is retained as an aspiration, not treated as a necessary or demonstrated property of the candidate.

original_dispositions.original_title: Molecular resolution of the hygiene hypothesis
original_dispositions.reason: Not added as a separate concept. Relevant causal exposure and microbial mechanisms are within IMM-11 and IMM-13. Explaining all historical population trends is a broad attribution problem; a separate transformative capability beyond those entries was not established.

original_dispositions.original_title: Prediction of individual repertoire development and response from birth
original_dispositions.reason: Covered in part: IMM-01 and IMM-02. Receptor recognition and general causal response prediction address the transformative capabilities. Predicting every individual’s complete lifetime repertoire is not required for either and is not presented as feasible.

original_dispositions.original_title: Conversion of cold tumors to responsive tumors
original_dispositions.reason: This is one possible route to general solid-tumor immune control, but immune entry alone would not overcome every resistance mechanism. The historical response-rate and cure claims are unsupported here.
Covered separately for autoimmunity and transplantation.
The historical claim of extending healthy lifespan by decades is not established.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Preserved IMM-01 through IMM-10 and their distinct first-pass concepts. Clarified that the seven HIV post-intervention controllers in IMM-07 included six people with detectable viremia; this is not seven cases of sustained viral suppression.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Preserve distinct concepts and clarify the HIV result.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added IMM-11 for the causal initiation of autoimmunity.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: It is related to but distinct from therapeutic tolerance in IMM-04.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added IMM-12, IMM-13 and IMM-14 for programmable trained immunity, causal microbiome–immune control and neuroimmune circuits.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Each represents a potentially general enabling principle rather than a single incremental treatment.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Narrowed historical claims of universality and automatic downstream cures. IMM-03 remains focused on broadly protective antibody evolution.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Its proposed cross-pathogen test is evidence of generality, not a claim that one vaccine will protect against every mutable virus.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Rechecked the five historical source links. The Nature DOI, NIAID, Lancet and Frontiers links could not be opened through the research tool; the Annual Reviews journal page timed out. Their asserted titles and claims that they enumerate all ten challenges were not verified and are not used as evidence for those assertions.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Access failure alone does not prove the sources do not exist.
